mapper.insert: INSERT INTO disease_diagnosis ( user_id, predicted_disease_name, disease_description, solution_text, symptom_summary, prevention_text, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{predictedDiseaseName}, #{diseaseDescription}, #{solutionText}, #{symptomSummary}, #{preventionText}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT diagnosis_id, user_id, predicted_disease_name, disease_description, solution_text, symptom_summary, prevention_text, created_at FROM disease_diagnosis WHERE diagnosis_id = #{diagnosisId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
